title: Sales & Marketing Executive – Corporate Food Services
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a result\-oriented Sales \& Marketing Executive to develop new business opportunities for Harlalka Kitchen.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and approaching corporates, educational institutions, hospitals, offices, and other organizations that require regular food\-service or catering solutions. The role will involve generating leads, meeting prospective clients, presenting our services, following up on enquiries, and converting opportunities into business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop new corporate and institutional business opportunities.
* Research and create a database of prospective corporate clients, schools, colleges, hospitals, offices, and other organizations.
* Approach decision\-makers through calls, emails, meetings, references, and direct visits.
* Understand client requirements related to corporate meals, cafeteria management, food supply, and catering.
* Present Harlalka Kitchen's food\-service capabilities and suitable service proposals to prospective clients.
* Arrange and conduct client meetings, presentations, food trials, and tastings when required.
* Prepare quotations and coordinate with the operations team to develop suitable commercial proposals.
* Follow up regularly with prospects and maintain a clear sales pipeline.
* Negotiate commercial terms within approved company guidelines and work towards closing new contracts.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Monitor competitor offerings and market opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, proposals, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and operations team during the client onboarding and service commencement process.

**Key Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing will be an advantage.
* 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales/business development, preferably in food services, catering, hospitality, facility management, or related industries.
* Experience in corporate sales and institutional sales will be preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Confident in approaching and meeting corporate decision\-makers.
* Target\-oriented and capable of independently generating new leads.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, email, and basic CRM/sales reporting.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings and business development.
* A strong network or existing contacts in the corporate/institutional sector will be an advantage.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Marketing Head
description:
Hittok Private Limited is a technology\-driven company engaged in software development, mobile applications, digital marketing, and innovative technology solutions. We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Marketing Head to lead our marketing team, develop strategic marketing plans, and drive business growth across our projects and brands.

Job Responsibilities1\. Marketing Strategy \& Planning

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Plan and execute marketing campaigns for company products, services, and projects.
* Identify new business opportunities, target audiences, and potential markets.
* Establish marketing goals, KPIs, and performance measurement systems.

2\. Digital Marketing \& Advertising

* Lead and manage advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads.
* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns to generate leads, app downloads, customer acquisition, and sales.
* Manage advertising budgets and ensure effective utilization of marketing expenditure.
* Monitor campaign performance, conversion rates, cost per lead, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
* Coordinate with creative and content teams for advertisements, promotional videos, banners, and marketing materials.

3\. Team Management \& Leadership

* Lead, manage, and supervise the marketing and digital marketing team.
* Assign responsibilities, set targets, and monitor individual and team performance.
* Train and guide marketing executives, digital marketers, and business development staff.
* Conduct regular team meetings and submit marketing progress reports to management.

4\. Brand Management \& Promotion

* Develop brand awareness and maintain a consistent brand identity across digital platforms.
* Manage promotional activities across social media, websites, and other marketing channels.
* Plan product launches, promotional campaigns, events, and customer engagement activities.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, retention, and brand visibility.

5\. Business Development \& Lead Generation

* Develop strategies to generate qualified business leads and convert them into customers.
* Identify potential clients, business partners, corporate clients, and strategic partnerships.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development teams to achieve revenue targets.
* Research competitors, industry trends, customer needs, and market opportunities.

6\. Reporting \& Performance Analysis

* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Analyze campaign data using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and other relevant tools.
* Monitor marketing KPIs, campaign expenditure, lead quality, and conversion performance.
* Recommend improvements based on campaign results and market research.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in marketing, digital advertising, or marketing team management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads campaign management.
* Experience in managing marketing teams, budgets, and business growth strategies.
* Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to develop marketing plans and achieve measurable business targets.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and marketing analytics tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

Performance Area

Key Measurement

Lead Generation

Qualified leads and enquiries generated

Advertising

Campaign performance and cost efficiency

Business Growth

Customer acquisition and revenue contribution

Team Management

Team productivity and target achievement

Brand Awareness

Reach, engagement, and brand visibility

Reporting

Timely reports and achievement of marketing objectives

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive salary based on experience and performance.
* Leadership opportunity to manage and grow the marketing department.
* Performance\-based incentives, subject to company policy.
* Professional growth opportunities within Hittok Private Limited.

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with details of their previous marketing experience, advertising campaign results, and team management experience.

* Proficiency in using CRM systems and data analytics tools for relationship management.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* A proactive and customer\-centric approach to work.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Manager with strong hands\-on expertise in planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other relevant performance marketing platforms. The candidate should be analytical, ROI\-focused, and capable of driving quality leads, conversions, and measurable business growth.

The candidate must also have practical knowledge of implementing AI tools in day\-to\-day performance marketing work. This includes using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI powered platforms for campaign research, ad copy ideation, audience analysis, reporting automation, competitor research, workflow improvement, and productivity enhancement.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Campaign Strategy \& Planning \- Plan and execute paid media strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other platforms. Build full\-funnel PPC campaigns for awareness, lead generation, remarketing, and conversions. Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, keyword research, and campaign forecasting. Define campaign objectives, budgets, KPIs, expected outcomes, and optimization roadmaps.  
2\. Google Ads Management Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and Remarketing campaigns. Conduct keyword research, negative keyword management, ad copy testing, and bid optimization. Optimize campaigns for CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, and budget efficiency. Monitor Quality Score, impression share, search terms, auction insights, and conversion performance.  
3\. Meta, LinkedIn \& Paid Social Campaigns Plan and manage campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other paid social platforms. Create audience segmentation, retargeting funnels, lookalike audiences, and creative testing plans. Coordinate with design and content teams to improve ad creatives, messaging, landing pages, and CTAs. Analyze campaign performance by audience, creative, placement, device, geography, and funnel stage.  
4\. AI Implementation in Day\-to\-Day PPC Work \- Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other relevant AI platforms to improve campaign planning, research, content ideation, and execution speed. Apply AI for keyword expansion, competitor research, landing page analysis, ad copy variations, headline testing, and campaign hypothesis creation.

Use AI\-assisted workflows for reporting summaries, performance insights, dashboard interpretation, and weekly optimization recommendations.   Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PPC tasks such as reporting, data interpretation, creative brief generation, lead quality analysis, and internal campaign documentation. Collaborate with marketing, content, design, and automation teams to integrate AI into campaign workflows without compromising quality, accuracy, or brand standards.

5\. Tracking, Analytics \& Reporting \- Set up and monitor conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Conversion APIs, and relevant CRM integrations. Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and next\-step recommendations. Track CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, impression share, and budget utilization. Identify campaign gaps, wasted spend, tracking issues, and opportunities for scale.

6\. Optimization \& Growth \- Continuously test ad copies, landing pages, audiences, bidding strategies, creatives, and campaign structures. Improve campaign performance through A/B testing, funnel analysis, data\-led optimization, and AI supported insights. Work with landing page, SEO, content, and sales teams to improve conversion quality and sales outcomes. Manage budgets efficiently and scale high\-performing campaigns.

7\. Team \& Stakeholder Coordination \- Coordinate with internal teams, designers, developers, content writers, sales teams, and automation teams. Present campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to management, clients, or stakeholders. Mentor junior PPC executives and guide them on campaign execution, reporting, optimization, and responsible use of AI tools. Maintain clear communication around campaign priorities, deadlines, blockers, and outcomes.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
